answer_prose: Race-week weather advisory from live /v1/race_forecasts (n=3, API as_of=2026-09-07T01:07:46Z). Cities: Berlin 2026 (partial_window), Chicago 2026 (awaiting_forecast_window), New York 2026 (awaiting_forecast_window). Race-morning summary fields (temp_c / feels_like_c at race start) are NOT YET AVAILABLE for any tracked city — Open-Meteo horizon has not covered race day; nulls are shown honestly and are never invented. Berlin 2026 (race_date=2026-09-27, start_local=09:15 Europe/Berlin) has a partial race-week lead-up window 2026-09-21..2026-09-22 (race week 2026-09-21..2026-09-27): n_hours=48, temp_c min/mean/max = 11.9/16.4/26.9 °C, feels_like min/max = 10.2/22.9 °C, humidity_pct_mean=62.6, precip_mm_sum=0.6, wind_mps mean/max = 3.43/5.6 (45 hourly rows with non-null temperature_2m of 48 listed). Chicago 2026 and New York 2026 remain awaiting_forecast_window stubs (null race-morning and null lead-up). SHOW limited to real lead-up coverage + coverage table; do not treat lead-up temps as race-morning advice. Historical Berlin HTW-by-band from RN3 (corpus, not 2026 forecast): cool HTW 16.8% (n=86,443); mild HTW 20.2% (n=199,341); warm HTW 25.5% (n=119,890); hot HTW 28.0% (n=45,846).
methodology_prose: Source: GET http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/race_forecasts (Open-Meteo forecast UPSERTs via race-data-platform scripts/fetch_race_week_forecast.py; writes race_forecasts only — never race_records). Pack stamps API n + fetched_at as_of. Race-morning scalars (temp_c, feels_like_c, …) stay null until fetched hours include race_date; pack never fills them. Berlin 2026 berlin_2026_forecast.csv = hourly_json fields only (temperature_2m, apparent_temperature, humidity, dewpoint, precip, weathercode, cloudcover, pressure_msl, wind); trailing null hours preserved. forecast_coverage.csv + null_race_morning_cities.csv list every city status. Optional rn3_berlin_htw_by_band.csv links historical RN3 HTW-by-band for Berlin context (cool/mild/warm/hot) — not a forecast. Maps to S9. Status=ready when any real lead-up window exists (Berlin partial), else coming-soon; always caveat race-morning null.

ux.note: Sight must not invent race-morning temps; bind coverage + Berlin lead-up only; show race-morning-not-yet-available caveat.
